note: Every entry wraps a script that already exists in scripts/ unless status is gap. status: ready (used in anger), partial (works, caveats listed), gap (not built). Default for every script is a dry run; --apply saves the game first. Run from the repo root.

commands.name: audit
commands.run: python scripts/fx.py bottlenecks [--area X1 Y1 X2 Y2] --json --top 15
commands.does: alerts, starved machine groups, missing ingredients, suspected lane jams, fix plan
commands.verify: findings list is empty or only known items

commands.name: science-rates
commands.does: per-pack made/s, used/s, lab stock; target = the slowest pack's rate raised to equal across the seven
commands.verify: all seven within 10 percent of each other
commands.workaround: scripts/autopilot_server.py SNAP prints made/s per pack once a minute into docs/autopilot.log

commands.name: discover
commands.does: list every generated resource patch (charted or not): size, distance to the bus, nearest rail, nests nearby
commands.workaround: the grouping snippet described in docs/new-patches.md (find_entities_filtered by resource name, group by 128 tile cells). Charting from RCON does not work and building does not need it

commands.name: clear
commands.run: python scripts/fx.py clear --area X1 Y1 X2 Y2 --all [--apply]
commands.does: trees, rocks, cliffs, enemies, decoratives, items in a box
commands.caveat: must never remove the crash site: entities named crash-site-spaceship* at about (-5,-6), wrecks out to (-39,7). Add that exclusion before an agent runs it near spawn
commands.verify: natural entity count in the box is 0

commands.name: pave
commands.run: python scripts/pave.py --box X1 Y1 X2 Y2 [--tile refined-concrete] --apply
commands.does: refined concrete floor (the Captain's 'foundation' for the ground) over a box, skipping water, ore and existing concrete

commands.name: rail-line
commands.run: python scripts/rail_plan.py --start X Y H --goal X Y H --min-run 16 --apply
commands.does: A* route between two open rail ends and lays it
commands.caveat: no signals or junctions: one train per track; min-run below 16 fails on corners; if placement stops, finish with rails.route and the printed legs
commands.verify: a train with the schedule leaves wait_station and arrives

commands.name: mine
commands.run: python scripts/fx.py mine --area X1 Y1 X2 Y2 --resource ORE --out N|E|S|W --apply
commands.does: dense drill rows on both sides of belt columns with poles, collector and output belt

commands.name: train-outpost
commands.run: python scripts/build_train_outpost.py --area X1 Y1 X2 Y2 --resource R --out N|S|E|W --furnaces N|0 --name NAME --stage outpost --apply
commands.does: mine + furnace block + merged output belt + 4-wagon load station (furnaces 0 means raw ore)

commands.name: yard-lane
commands.run: python scripts/build_yard.py yard --y Y --lane X --name NAME --apply ; python scripts/build_yard.py stub --stub X Y0 Y1 --dir N|S --apply
commands.does: unload track, stop, 24 bulk inserters on the tile next to the rail and 24 red provider chests behind them at the bus head (drones carry the plates on; --lane is ignored); rail stub at the outpost
commands.caveat: take Y from the registry (state.json); the row needs roboport cover; the first version (inserters two tiles from the rail, a belt lane) never unloaded a plate
commands.verify: after one train visit the provider chests hold cargo and the wagons are emptier

commands.name: fluid-train-oil
commands.run: python scripts/build_oil_train.py --area X1 Y1 X2 Y2 --rail X STOP_Y --apply
commands.does: pumpjacks on every well, BFS pipes, header, pumps, stop
commands.caveat: the unload yard for fluid (3 pumps + 2 tanks) was done inline and is not a script yet

commands.name: uranium-outpost
commands.does: drills with sulfuric acid by fluid train (or local acid), ore train to the uranium site

commands.name: cells
commands.run: python scripts/build_cells.py --kind steel|cable|ec|ac|lds|foundation --origin X Y --count N --apply
commands.does: drone-fed production rows: requester chest, inserter, machine, inserter, provider chest
commands.verify: no out_of_logistic_network or no_power; machines working

commands.name: pu-block
commands.does: processing unit assemblers on the acid line

commands.name: silos
commands.does: rocket silos with drone-fed parts and cargo

commands.name: logistics-convert
commands.run: python scripts/fx.py logistics survey|convert|retire --area X1 Y1 X2 Y2 [--apply]
commands.does: belt-fed machines to drone chests, then remove unused belts
commands.caveat: convert whole chains; check every raw input has a provider chest

commands.name: upgrade
commands.run: python scripts/fx.py upgrade --area X1 Y1 X2 Y2 --all [--modules speed --module-name N --budget-mw N] --apply
commands.does: belts, inserters, machines, poles, furnaces to the best researched tier; module fill
commands.caveat: storage chests are for trash yards only (the --storage option was removed)

commands.name: roboport-grid
commands.caveat: running it grows the revealed map; grid pieces removed by rail or outpost builds need a restore pass (--restore-near)

commands.name: autopilot
commands.does: research queue, platform ice-jam repair, power guard for silos and outposts, log in docs/autopilot.log
commands.caveat: runs from the PC as a foreground process; installing it as a VM service was refused (persistence)
